title.narrative: accelerating access to prevention and treatment of tuberculosis towards attaining the MDGs - Ghana (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Ghana, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Ghana (Ghana MOH)This program has the following goals: To end the TB epidemic in Ghana by 2035 without catastrophic cost due to TB affected families. To reduce by 20% the 2013 TB prevalence baseline level of 264 per 100,000 population by 2020 in line with post 2015 Global TB control strategy. To reduce by 35% the 2012 TB mortality rate baseline of 4 deaths per 100,000 population by 2020 in line with post 2015 Global TB control strategy. The objectives of this program are: To attain higher treatment success for all forms of TB from 84% in 2012 to at least 91% by 2020 through improved quality clinical care and community TB care. To early detect and enrol into treatment at least 85% of confirmed MDR-TB cases among new and previously treated cases by 2020. To early screen, detect and enrol into treatment all forms of notified (new cases) from 15,606 in 2013 to 37,302 by 2020, while increasing the proportion of bacteriologically confirmed pulmonary TB from 49% in 2013 to 60% by 2020. To improve Programme management; coordination Monitoring & Evaluation and operations research to support treatment and screening strategies for TB/HIV. To reduce death rates of TB/HIV co-infected cases from 20% in 2012 to 10% by 2020 and uptake of ART coverage among co-infected from 37% in 2013% to 90% by 2020
